welcome.title: Welcome to ToothOps
welcome.body: A 60-second tour of where everything lives. You can replay it any time from Settings → Getting started.

sections.title: The eight sections
sections.body: A dental record, top to bottom. Work down these in order or jump around — everything autosaves.

patient.title: Patient & owner
patient.body: Name, owner contact, and the recheck date. Only the patient name is required to save.

species.title: Species & dentition
species.body: Pick Feline or Canine, then Permanent or Deciduous — the tooth layout follows.

grid.title: The charting grid
grid.body: Per-tooth measurements. Tab moves across, Enter moves down — chart without looking up.

diagrams.title: Diagrams
diagrams.body: Click a tooth to mark it; switch between Comment and Draw, add free notes. Undo with ⌘Z.

codes.title: Code reference
codes.body: Search the full AVDC code set here; it stays pinned beside the diagram as you scroll.

treatment.title: Treatment report & templates
treatment.body: Write the report, or insert a saved template from the dropdown — and save new ones to reuse.

library.title: My charts
library.body: Open any patient’s charts (saved visits open read-only until you Edit), or — for the patient on screen — start a new visit or see its version history. New patient, beside it, starts a blank chart.

dictate.title: Dictate
dictate.body: Tap Dictate and talk through your findings — from any page. Each one lands in the right place, and a live panel shows every change so you can undo anything.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Practice name & logo, team, recheck-reminder templates, your account — and this tour.

pdf.title: Preview & download the PDF
pdf.body: Build the client-ready chart PDF with your logo whenever you’re ready.

finishSetup.title: Finish setting up
finishSetup.both: Your practice and doctor name appear on every chart you print.
finishSetup.practiceOnly: Your practice name appears on every chart you print.
finishSetup.doctorOnly: Your doctor name appears on every chart you print.
finishSetup.logoHint: Printed at the top of your charts. PNG, JPG or WebP.
finishSetup.namesNeeded: Both names are needed — they appear on your charts.
finishSetup.logoFailed: Your names are saved, but the logo couldn’t be uploaded — add it later in Practice settings.

join.title: Join {{practice}}?
join.invited: You’ve been invited to join {{practice}} on ToothOps. Members share the practice’s charts, report templates and recheck list, and new charts you save are shared with the team.
join.shareExisting: Also share the charts I’ve already made
